notes: Deterministic registry for the stable-owned G1.1 skill detector/preparer (.github/workflows/stable-skills-maintenance.yml, scripts/skill_updates/). It records ONE fact each provider manifest deliberately omits: the upstream branch a human reviewed and agreed is the right place to inspect for drift. The manifest still owns the pin (upstream_commit, a 40-hex sha); this file owns only the ref. Nothing here widens trust: the engine resolves the ref to a concrete sha and proves it, and no floating ref enters the vendored tree. G1.1 is artifact-only and automatic_updates remains false: it cannot publish, audit, mark Ready, merge, auto-merge, or install sibling skills. At adoption main remains the repository default while release/0.3 is non-default, so the stable workflow is UNCOMMISSIONED pending separate owner migration and liveness commissioning. The registry remains the canonical provider set and reviewed-ref record consumed by scripts/validate-agent-governance.py. Full detail: docs/agents/skills-update-automation.md.

providers.notes: 23 installed skills, MIT, shared licence notice at .claude/skills/LICENSE. Upstream organizes skills by category (skills/<category>/<name>); agents/openai.yaml is deliberately never vendored (Codex sidecar, see the policy).
3 installed skills, Apache-2.0, per-skill LICENSE.txt. skill-creator is vendored under the renamed directory skill-creator-anthropic to avoid a built-in name collision.
23 installed skills, CC BY-SA 4.0, per-skill LICENSE. Section 3(a)(1) requires the licence notice to travel with every distributed copy.

AUDIT-ONLY MONITOR -- nothing from this repository is vendored and the bot will never prepare a candidate for it. It was reviewed and rejected on provenance grounds: at the baseline commit there is no root licence, and the tree's only licence file is an MIT hallmark/LICENSE held by 'Hallmark contributors', which by directory convention plausibly covers hallmark/ alone (see docs/agents/builderio-skills-policy.md). The null baselines are the reviewed finding, so a root licence APPEARING is the signal worth reporting -- that is the condition under which the exclusion decision would be worth revisiting, by a human, in a separate review.
